reports.availability.v1_note: v1 counted bookable slots in code (availability.ts) and raised a low-availability alert (H7); in a run about a booking, only that booking's calendar is read

reports.eod_due.v1_note: v1 computed this in code (eod.ts): { days: [{ day, label, when, url, today, calls, ghl_blank, both }], count, overdue: [{ day, label, names }], overdue_count }

reports.health_check.v1_note: v1 ran the hourly sweep in code (health.ts) and raised its findings as alerts (H7); its repairs (H5, H6) are GAP 9

reports.leaderboard.v1_note: v1 built the leaderboard in code (leaderboard.ts): closers by cash with closes and close rate, setters by sets with the show rate of their sets; body is the phone-width text
